help.embeddingModel: Model that converts text to vectors. Cannot be changed after creation — rebuild KB to switch models
help.chunkSize: Target character count per chunk. Larger = more context but lower precision. Recommended: 512~1024
help.chunkOverlap: Overlapping characters between adjacent chunks. Prevents semantic truncation. Recommended: 10%~20% of chunk size
help.chunkStrategy: Recursive: splits by headings/paragraphs/sentences, best for most docs; Semantic: splits by meaning similarity, best for long text; Paragraph: splits by natural paragraphs, best for well-formatted docs
help.searchMode: Hybrid combines vector semantic matching with keyword exact matching for best results. Pure vector for semantic search, pure keyword for exact term lookup
help.topK: Number of most relevant chunks returned per retrieval. Higher = more comprehensive but may introduce noise
help.scoreThreshold: Results scoring below this are filtered out. Higher = stricter, 0 = no filtering. Recommended: 0.3~0.7
help.uploadTypes: Supported: PDF, Word (.docx), TXT, Markdown (.md), CSV. Max recommended file size: 20MB
help.statusDesc: Pending → Parsing → Chunking → Embedding → Completed. Click retry if any step fails

deleteConfirm: Delete knowledge base "{name}"? All documents and chunks will be permanently deleted.
